b'# tinydl CLI Reference

**CLI entry point for the `tinydl` project.**

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <url> [options]
```

## Positional Arguments

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |

## Optional Arguments

| Option | Help Text |
|--------|-----------|
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Description

`tinydl` downloads a file from a given URL and writes the output to a specified file or stdout. If `--quiet` is not set, it prints the size of the downloaded data to stderr.'
